```{r}
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

Read in data
```{r}
metadata <- read.table("../CriptoFc/data/meta/DE_AZ_samples.txt", header = TRUE)
estfact <- read.csv("../CriptoFc/results/DE/estFactors_normalized_counts.csv")

# Select data to plot
data <- estfact[estfact$X %in% c("CriptoFC", "ULK1", "ULK1transient"),]
genes <- c("CriptoFC", "ULK1", "ULK1transient")

# Data for genes of interest
data <- estfact[estfact$X %in% genes,]
```


# Barplots individual genes across groups
```{r}
for (gene in genes){
  
  data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(X == gene)
  
  summary_stats <- data_long %>%
    group_by(X, short_name) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_expression = mean(expression),
      sd_expression = sd(expression),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  vst_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = short_name, y = mean_expression)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sd_expression, ymax = mean_expression + sd_expression),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Counts (median of ratios norm)", title=gene) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
      )
  
  pdf(paste0("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/", gene, ".pdf"), width = 5, height = 6)  # 6x6 inches
  print(vst_plot)
  dev.off()
    
}

```

# Display y legend with 10^instead of e
```{r}
scientific_10 <- function(x) {
  parse(text=gsub("e","%*%10^", scales::scientific_format()(x)))
}
```


```{r}
metadata <- read.table("../CriptoFc/data/meta/DE_AZ_samples.txt", header = TRUE)
estfact <- read.csv("../CriptoFc/results/DE/estFactors_normalized_counts.csv")

# Select data to plot
data <- estfact[estfact$X %in% c("CriptoFC", "ULK1", "ULK1transient"),]
genes <- c("CriptoFC", "ULK1", "ULK1transient")

# Data for genes of interest
data <- estfact[estfact$X %in% genes,]

data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(X == "CriptoFC")

summary_stats <- data_long %>%
  group_by(X, short_name) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_expression = mean(expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_stats
```


Figure 1C
- Plot CriptoFc cytometry and transcript levels
- Cytometry data from CriptoFc_quant.Rmd
```{r}
# Read in cytometry data from 
cytometry <- read.table("../CriptoFc/data/other/mean_CriptoFc_cytometry.csv", header = TRUE, sep=",")


data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(X == "CriptoFC")

summary_stats <- data_long %>%
  group_by(X, short_name) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_expression = mean(expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge to plot
df_merged <- cytometry %>%
  inner_join(summary_stats, by = "short_name") %>%
  dplyr::select(short_name, mean_expression, CriptoFc_cytometry)

# Linear model
model <- lm(mean_expression ~ CriptoFc_cytometry, data = df_merged)
r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared

cytometry_plot <- ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = CriptoFc_cytometry, y = mean_expression)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black",linetype = 3, size=0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = short_name), hjust = 0.3, vjust = -0.8, size = 4) +
  #ylim(4000000, 12000000) +
  xlim(0, 700000) +
  scale_y_continuous(label=scientific_10) +
  labs(x = "Median Cripto-Fc(RL1-H) of Live cells", y = "Cripto-Fc (median of ratios)", title=paste0("Cytometry and transcripts R² = ", round(r2, 4))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )

pdf("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/CriptoFc_cytometry.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)  # 6x6 inches
print(cytometry_plot)
dev.off()

```


Figure 1D
Plot scatterplot CriptoFc vs ULK1 transcript levels
```{r}
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")

summary_stats <- data_long %>%
  group_by(X, short_name) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_expression = mean(expression),
    sd_expression = sd(expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_stats_wide <- summary_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(-sd_expression) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(short_name %in% c("Expi293_CriptoFC_ULK1",
                                    "Vulko293_CriptoFC_ULK1",
                                    "Expi293_neg",
                                    "Vulko293_neg"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "X", values_from = "mean_expression"
)


# Linear model
model <- lm(CriptoFC ~ ULK1, data = summary_stats_wide)
r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared

expression_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats_wide, aes(x = ULK1, y = CriptoFC)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black",linetype = 3, size=0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = short_name), hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4) +
  ylim(4000000, 12000000) +
  xlim(100, 500) +
  scale_y_continuous(label=scientific_10) +
  labs(x = "ULK1", y = "Cripto-Fc", title=paste0("Counts (median of ratios norm), R² = ", round(r2, 4))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )

pdf("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/CriptoFc_ULK1.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)  # 6x6 inches
print(expression_plot)
dev.off()

```
